name: Roland Fantom-X6/X7/X8
description: Roland Fantom-X6, Fantom-X7 and Fantom-X8 workstations (2004; one sound engine, one address map): the setup and system blocks, the temporary performance (common, MFX 1-3, chorus, reverb, and every part's Part, MIDI and Zone blocks), both modes' temporary arpeggio, chord pattern and rhythm group, and Patch Mode Part 1's patch and rhythm set, from the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation in the owner's manual.

sources.title: Fantom-X6/X7/X8 MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, Feb. 2, 2004)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from FANTOM-X6_X7_X8_OM.pdf (sha256 5d3fde563d7e382cb0b4b91727daad0f8bf99fedb736eadbc934a73da908c5ca). Model ID 00 6B, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

Patch Mode Part 1 (1F 00 00 00) is laid out as the keyboard part: the map does not name the two Patch-mode parts, and the Setup (Kbd Patch at 00 04-00 06, then Pad Patch at 00 07-00 09) and System Common (Kbd Patch Rx/Tx Channel 00 0A, then Pad Patch 00 0B) put the keyboard first. Its patch is at 1F 00 00 00 and its rhythm set at 1F 10 00 00, the key blocks from 1F 10 10 00 (key 21) two apart.

Rhythm set keys 35 (B1) to 81 (A5), the General MIDI percussion map, are laid out: 47 of the 88. Keys 21-34 (1F 10 10 00 to 1F 10 2A 00) and 82-108 (1F 11 0A 00 to 1F 11 3E 00) are not, to keep the profile under 12,000 parameters; each is one more Rhythm Tone block, 00 02 00 apart.

Not laid out: the sixteen Performance Mode parts' own patches and rhythm sets, at 11 00 00 00, 11 20 00 00, … 14 60 00 00 (part n at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) × 00 20 00 00, a patch at +00 00 00 and a rhythm set at +10 00 00). Each is the Patch-mode blocks again.
Not laid out: Patch Mode Part 2 (1F 20 00 00), the pad part: a patch at 1F 20 00 00 and a rhythm set at 1F 30 00 00, the same blocks as Part 1's.
Not laid out: the Temporary Rhythm Pattern (1E 00 00 00). The top table names it and the map prints no table for it.

Identity (p306): the three sizes reply F0 7E dev 06 02 41 6B 01 00 01 rr 03 00 00 F7 with rr = 00 (X6), 01 (X7), 02 (X8): family code 6B 01, family number 00 01 for all three, so one profile answers each. The Fantom-XR's manual (p251) prints the same family code and number, with a software revision of 03 00 00 00 against the Fantom-X's rr 03 00 00. Profiles match on family and number, not revision, so roland-fantom-x and roland-fantom-xr each accept the other's instrument. Unconfirmed on hardware.

Presets list the Patches and Rhythm Sets (Bank Select MSB 87 and 86) from the Correspondence Chart (p330), recalled on the profile's channel, which is the Kbd Patch Rx/Tx Channel (System Common 00 0A) in Patch mode. p298's Bank Select table prints Preset Rhythm "001 - 032" at 86/64 and elides Preset Patch C-H with ":"; the chart (PRST 001-040) and the specifications ("Rhythm Sets: 40 + 9 (GM2)", p333) agree on forty, so forty are listed. Performances (MSB 85: User 000, Card 032, Preset 064, 64 each) are selected on the Performance Control Channel and are not listed; nor are the GM2 (MSB 120/121) or SRX expansion (MSB 92/93) banks, whose sizes the manual does not print.

Performance Common MFX (p314) prints MFX Type as (0 - 78) with "0 - 127" on its display line; Patch Common MFX (p320) and Rhythm Common MFX (p323) print (0 - 127). The effects chapter (p211) says "Value: 0 (Through)–78". Each is kept as its table prints it.
Setup Sound Mode (p311) prints its values as "PATCH, PERFORM, GM1, GM2, GS, PIANO<*>": the last label carries the "<*>" mark the map uses for values ignored on receipt, and is kept as printed.

Beam Trigger Pad is (0 - 15) in both places it is printed, with the display line "1 - 16" in the System Controller (p313) and "1 - 15" in the Performance Controller (p316); sixteen values are 1-16. Each is kept as printed.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): patch, patch.mfx, patch.chorus, patch.reverb, patch.tmt, patch.tone1, patch.tone2, patch.tone3, patch.tone4, rhythm, rhythm.mfx, rhythm.chorus, rhythm.reverb, rhythm.key35, rhythm.key36, rhythm.key37, rhythm.key38, rhythm.key39, rhythm.key40, rhythm.key41, rhythm.key42, rhythm.key43, rhythm.key44, rhythm.key45, rhythm.key46, rhythm.key47, rhythm.key48, rhythm.key49, rhythm.key50, rhythm.key51, rhythm.key52, rhythm.key53, rhythm.key54, rhythm.key55, rhythm.key56, rhythm.key57, rhythm.key58, rhythm.key59, rhythm.key60, rhythm.key61, rhythm.key62, rhythm.key63, rhythm.key64, rhythm.key65, rhythm.key66, rhythm.key67, rhythm.key68, rhythm.key69, rhythm.key70, rhythm.key71, rhythm.key72, rhythm.key73, rhythm.key74, rhythm.key75, rhythm.key76, rhythm.key77, rhythm.key78, rhythm.key79, rhythm.key80, rhythm.key81.

coverage.rhythmKeys: partial: keys 35-81 of Patch Mode Part 1's rhythm set (47 of 88); 21-34 (1F 10 10 00-1F 10 2A 00) and 82-108 (1F 11 0A 00-1F 11 3E 00) are not laid out
coverage.performancePartTones: not modelled: the patches and rhythm sets of the 16 Performance Mode parts (11 00 00 00 to 14 60 00 00, step 00 20 00 00)
coverage.notModelled: Patch Mode Part 2, the pad part (1F 20 00 00: patch at 1F 20 00 00, rhythm set at 1F 30 00 00); Temporary Rhythm Pattern (1E 00 00 00, no table in the map); user memories, samples and patterns; the GS address map (model ID 42, p326-327), which GS sound mode answers to
